name: Shiroya Tool Lab
description: Fast, private browser-based utilities platform built by Vraj Shiroya (VG31OP). 100% client-side execution with zero cloud storage.

tools.name: Web Shiroya
tools.description: Website source code extractor, DOM tree hierarchy inspector, and Tailwind CSS component breakdown engine.
tools.privacy: In-browser DOM parsing without intermediary logging.

tools.name: Drop
tools.description: Encrypted peer-to-peer file transfer engine using WebRTC RTCDataChannel with DTLS encryption.
tools.privacy: Zero cloud storage; files stream directly between peer browser instances.

tools.name: BgZero
tools.description: Client-side AI image background remover and transparent PNG export utility.
tools.privacy: 100% local browser execution using client-side canvas and vision models.

tools.name: PDF Tools
tools.description: In-memory browser PDF merger, splitter, page organizer, and compression utility.
tools.privacy: In-memory WebAssembly processing; confidential documents are never uploaded to remote servers.

tools.name: Network-Speed-Combiner
tools.description: Bandwidth bonding and multi-interface network routing experiment combining concurrent physical connections.
tools.privacy: Local socket orchestration without third-party proxying.
